infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MansaMart uses your location to show nearby products, services, vendors, riders, and delivery tracking.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: MansaMart can use background location during active deliveries so shoppers, vendors, and riders can track orders safely.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MansaMart uses the camera for profile photos, document uploads, product images, and QR verification.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MansaMart needs photo library access for profile photos, product images, business documents, and ID verification uploads.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: MansaMart may save generated QR codes or receipts to your photo library when requested.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow MansaMart to use your location during active deliveries.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow MansaMart to access photos for uploads.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow MansaMart to use the camera for uploads and QR checks.
